usedFor: Zoho CRM holds the new deals and accounts, and ApexVerify checks emails and phone numbers. A “New Account” in Zoho CRM can run “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify to get a quality result for the contact.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: Checking one contact as the account appears catches bad details before anyone writes to it. “Create Verification Batch” prepares an uploaded list and gives no result per contact.

watchOut: “New Account” and “New Deals” are polling, so the check runs on a schedule. “Verify Email or Phone” needs a verification type and a target country chosen up front.
